meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建动画文本、图表、地图或UI动画等动态图形短片。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需快速制作无旁白的动态图形视频。
copy.tagline_en: Create kinetic typography, data charts, map animations, or UI motion graphics in seconds.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce short, design-led motion graphics without narration.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会制作时长通常在 10 秒内、无旁白的短运动图形(动态文字、数字跳动、图表、Logo 片头、地图动效、网页/推文动画等),先规划、构建、检查,最后询问预览或渲染,输出 MP4 或透明背景视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作时长约 10 秒内、无旁白的短运动图形,如动态文字、数字跳动、Logo 片头、动画地图等时触发。更长或有旁白的需求会转到其它流程。

say.text: 做一个 8 秒的 Logo 片头,不加旁白
say.note: 先规划构建,渲染前会问是否预览

say.text: 把这段数据做成 10 秒内的数字跳动动画
say.note: 走 stat/图表类短动画流程

say.text: 给这条推文做一个 6 秒的动态卡片
say.note: 会搜索推文内容再生成动画

howto.what_en: Claude makes short (<10s) narration-free motion graphics (kinetic text, count-ups, charts, logo stings, maps, tweet/news, webpage UI, etc.). It plans, sources, builds, verifies, asks preview-or-render, outputs MP4 or transparent WebM/MOV.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short (<10s), narration-free motion graphic such as kinetic type, stat count-up, logo sting, map, etc. Longer/narrated go to /general-video; unclear to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make an 8-second logo sting, no narration.
say_en.note: It plans, builds, verifies, then asks before rendering.

say_en.text: Turn this data into a count-up animation under 10 seconds.
Make a 6-second animated card for this tweet.
say_en.note: Searches the link and generates the animation.
